transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. To start off, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

What brought me in is I can’t keep my mind on one thing anymore. At the bench, I’ll start with a customer email, then notice a saw mark, hear something outside, and suddenly I’ve lost track of the whole work order.
Has this trouble staying focused been a lifelong pattern since childhood, or is it something that started more recently?

It’s more recent. I didn’t used to be like this at work—now I’ll be doing an email, spot a saw mark or hear a noise outside, and I’m off on that. Then I look back and can’t remember where I was with the order.
Besides losing focus, have you noticed yourself feeling persistently worried or on edge about multiple things—work, health, family—that's hard to control?
No, I wouldn’t say I’m constantly worried about a bunch of things. It’s more that my attention just keeps getting pulled away.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy over this same period?
Yeah. The last couple weeks, I’ve been waking up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like the shine’s gone out of everything. I’ve even cried sitting in my truck before opening the shop.
Have you had any new or worsening medical problems, illnesses, or changes in medications recently, around the same time these mood and focus changes started?
I’m not sure. I haven’t noticed anything new medically or any recent changes like that around when this started.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep or appetite, or a drop in your energy level, over these past couple of weeks?
My energy’s way down. My arms feel like lead at the bench, and even polishing a setting or carrying a tray of stones wipes me out. A full night off doesn’t seem to fix it.
Have you noticed any other new symptoms like headaches, memory lapses, confusion, weakness, or changes in vision along with these mood and concentration issues?
No, I haven’t really noticed anything else like that. It’s mostly the mood, trouble focusing, and feeling worn out.
Over these past couple of weeks, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that you'd be better off dead?
Yeah… I keep thinking my family and my clients would be better off if I wasn’t around. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself, but it scares me how often those thoughts come up.

Over the past couple of weeks, how much have these mood and energy problems affected your ability to keep the shop running and manage your daily responsibilities—are you still able to get through most tasks, or has it become very difficult to function at all?

It’s become pretty difficult. I missed a major custom delivery, and my shop records got so disorganized that I had to stop taking new work for now. My family’s been checking on me more too—they were worried because I’d fallen so far out of my usual routines.
